From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 11:02:10 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposed DPA redlines and subprocessor inventory

Soojin — I reviewed Acme's redlines and prepared a short memo below. High-level: we can accept most of their edits subject to three changes and one structural ask (Annex for transfers).

Summary of counsel notes (Redwood comment reference numbers included):
1) Subprocessor notice and acceptance (comment R-01): Acme's draft requires acceptance of any new subprocessor within 14 days. Recommend counter: Redwood will provide notice and a 30-day review window; silence does not equal acceptance. This protects us operationally while giving customers time to object.

2) Transfers and SCCs (R-02): Acme requests a specific transfer annex calling out SCCs + supplementary measures. Recommend drafting "Annex 2: Transfer Mechanisms" that references the EU Commission SCCs and describes the supplementary measures we apply (e.g., encryption at rest/in transit, processor-only access controls). This keeps the main DPA compact and addresses their auditor request.

3) Liability cap carve-outs (R-03): Their redline adds broad carve-outs. We should accept carve-outs for gross negligence/willful misconduct and unlimited claims for data breaches involving regulators/fines only where required by law. Propose tightening the language so general indemnities don't swallow the cap.

4) Security annex granularity (R-04): Their security requirements are specific (90-day pen test cadence, certain ISO controls). Recommend: propose a Security Annex with our SOC 2 scope, yearly pen test cadence, and a commitment to share summary reports under NDA. For immediate procurement, provide SOC 2 Type II report and a short security fact sheet.

Execution & e-sign (R-05): Acme prefers DocuSign. Confirmed DocuSign envelopes are acceptable. For enterprise customers we typically execute the DPA as a standalone annex in DocuSign with a primary signatory (VP Legal). Ask Acme to confirm signatory and whether they require countersignature in a specific DocuSign account.

Next steps (recommended):
- I will produce a short redline (Redwood_Comments_DPA_v1.docx) addressing R-01 through R-04 and draft Annex 2 for transfers.
- Soojin: propose we offer Acme the subprocessor list "as disclosed" for initial term with 30-day notice for additions.
- Vivek: please prepare SOC 2 summary and confirm whether we need an escalation lane for requests to see pen test reports (we prefer summary + under-NDA full reports).

I estimate we can get Redwood's redline back to Acme within 48 hours if no legal hold.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Comments_DPA_v1.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Dunn <alice.dunn@acme.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 10:25:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed DPA redlines and subprocessor inventory

Alice — thanks for sending these over and for your patience while our counsel reviewed. Key points below and proposed path to execution: 

1) Subprocessors: Redwood can accept the subprocessor CSV as disclosed for the initial term, subject to 30 days' prior notice for additions. If Acme needs an approval gate on certain provider classes, let us know which ones and we will discuss.

2) Transfers: We will add a short Annex 2 that references the EU Commission SCCs and documents Redwood's supplementary technical and organizational measures. This should satisfy your auditor and procurement.

3) Liability and security: Counsel proposes limited carve-outs (gross negligence/willful misconduct and where law requires). We'll provide our SOC 2 Type II report and a brief security factsheet; full pen test reports available under NDA if required.

4) Execution: We can execute the finalized DPA via DocuSign. Please confirm the signatory name and whether Acme requires the envelope to come from a particular DocuSign account.

Proposed timeline:
- Mon/Tue: Redwood sends counter-redline with Annex 2 included.
- Wed/Thu: Acme reviews counter and confirms signatory.
- End of next week: execute DPA via DocuSign.

If that works, we'll send the counter today/tomorrow.

Thanks,
Soojin
